decision_scope: APPROVE_ONLY_THE_PROPOSAL_TO_USE_THE_CLOSED_VALI_KE_PARAZAMI_KE_SOURCE_PACKAGE_FOR_NONCANONICAL_INTERNAL_POSITION_1; DO_NOT_ASSIGN_POSITION_1, CREATE_CANONICAL_SLOT_IDS_OR_LABELS, AUTHOR_OR_VALIDATE_OPI, UNLOCK_QA, CHANGE_STR003_STR005, GENERALIZE_KE, OR_ACTIVATE_RUNTIME

proposal_decisions.statement: Approve proposing the closed VALI KE / PARAZAMI KE source package for internal position selector 1.
Keep selector 1 noncanonical and do not treat it as a slot ID or label.
Keep the source package closed to VALI KE and PARAZAMI KE only.
Do not assign position 1 or consume an OPI slot in this proposal gate.
Do not author or validate OPI, unlock QA/STR003-STR005, generalize KE or alter lexical authority.
If approved, open only a separate first-position allocation application gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: Proposal approval is not positional assignment, OPI authoring or OPI validation.
No canonical OPI slot ID or label is created by this proposal.
No subject/person, tense/aspect or copula semantics are introduced or inferred.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or question-to-declarative derivation is created.
DARUNO/NELARA parent lexeme gate and HNK3000 remain untouched.
A future SIGA may approve only this first-position source-package proposal while this gate remains active.
